label: Был построен
description: A 10-sentence card for the periphrastic быть plus short participle passive.

missions.phrase: Этот дом был построен очень давно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine periphrastic passive. This is passive voice with быть plus the short participle, был построен meaning was built. Дом is the subject and the masculine был agrees with it.

missions.phrase: Это письмо было написано вчера утром.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Neuter periphrastic passive. Было написано pairs neuter было with the short participle, the perfective passive was written. Письмо is the neuter subject acted upon.
Strategic focus: Present zero copula passive. Сделана и проверена are short participles with no overt быть, so the present copula is zero. The feminine работа is done and checked.

missions.phrase: Магазин будет открыт завтра в девять.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Future periphrastic passive. Будет открыт uses future будет with the short participle, will be opened. Магазин is the masculine subject of this perfective passive.

missions.phrase: Эта книга была написана за месяц.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine periphrastic passive. Была написана joins feminine была with the short participle, was written. Книга is the feminine subject acted upon by an unnamed author.

missions.phrase: Все окна были вымыты к празднику.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural periphrastic passive. Были вымыты pairs plural были with the short participle, were washed. Окна are the plural subject undergoing the action.
Strategic focus: Feminine periphrastic passive. Была закрыта uses feminine была and the short participle, was locked. Дверь is the subject, the perfective result still in place.

missions.phrase: Этот вопрос будет решён очень скоро.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Future periphrastic passive with ё. Будет решён combines future будет with the short participle, will be solved. Вопрос is the masculine subject of the perfective passive.
Strategic focus: Plural periphrastic passive. Были потеряны pairs plural были with the short participle, were lost. Деньги are the plural subject affected by the action.
Strategic focus: Periphrastic passive with instrumental agent. Был приготовлен is быть plus the short participle, was prepared. The agent мамой stands in the instrumental as the one who cooked.
